question: Can the AC1018 TABLE body encoder safely re-emit the exact retained zero-mask override spans observed in the bounded physical peer profile?

observedSignature: One complete 10-bit r2007-table-cell-overrides span with count 0 for each populated plain-text cell; all cell override and virtual-edge flags are zero.
One complete 4-bit r2007-table-overrides span with count 0, representing the absent table-mask bit and three absent border-mask bits.
Ranges are ordered, non-overlapping, AC1018-only, and end before no unknown retained tail.
evidence.limits: The physical source is one ODA-converted profile with an unrelated HEADER integrity warning. It is not native AutoCAD output or strict whole-source output evidence.

implementation.behavior: DRW_Table::encodeDwg now admits non-empty retained subrecord ranges only when they exactly match the complete, ordered, zero-mask AC1018 signature above and the model has one populated text item per cell-record span. Each range must also have rawHandleCode zero. Unknown names, versions, counts, sizes, handle codes, ordering, truncation, nonzero override values, and additional ranges remain refused. The generated whole-file TABLE profile remains independently bounded; this change does not authorize conversion of the physical source drawing.
implementation.control: A from-scratch merged-table model receives the exact range records parsed from its generated body, re-encodes, reads back typed cell values and merge fields, and preserves the following-body sentinel. A 9-bit cell span and a nonzero raw-handle code each refuse without altering seeded body/handle buffers; correcting both fields on the same object permits retry.

validation.result: Build succeeded; selector passed; the implementation slice initially passed both the cell-override and whole-file TABLE CTests (2/2), and the follow-up raw-handle guard passed the cell-override CTest (1/1).

disposition: Closes only direct-codec admission for the observed zero-mask span shape. It does not decode cell semantics independently, qualify native rendering, broaden TABLE producer support, or remove whole-source refusal gates. No drawing fixture was added.
